name: Early session entry notification
description: Send a durable standalone session link at first request admission, before the model finishes; preserve receipts and omit the completed-reply footer.
verification_plan: Block the fake model, claim and acknowledge the entry before its result exists, then verify no footer, duplicate/concurrent admission, archive/restart and full npm test.
rollout: Not deployed: production still uses the legacy runtime schema. Feishu uses the shared outbox; other adapters retain their existing first-reply footer.
